method: Read current contract/guide and exact named native/applicability/budget receipts and fixture source; independently rehash core player payloads across four commits and both candidate ZIPs. Preserve native endpoint/source identities. No native execution or new host timing.

matrix.subject: get_version / get_capabilities
matrix.targets: F200 Base; F210 Base and Space Age
matrix.observed: Data imports check version/capability; actual runtime calls return detached records in required Alpha and optional Beta. Both EN/DE clients repeat read-only load queries at initial/rejoin/saved-host restart.
matrix.limit: No generic support certificate, unknown capability or old-engine public-operation promise. API major/minor and product version remain distinct.

matrix.subject: add_technologies / immediate publication / local forward references / returned order
matrix.targets: F200 Base; F210 Base; F210 Space Age data/client worlds
matrix.observed: Alpha data.lua immediately creates two named rows, returns caller order, and permits its alpha-1 -> alpha-2 forward reference. Native +0.05 crafting modifier and public queries are observed. Two independently installed consumers share only the public API.
matrix.limit: Original native research uses setters, not labs. Arbitrary family shapes are not native-qualified by this small family.

matrix.subject: add_productivity / late final-fixes / native physical effect
matrix.targets: F200 Base D3; F210 Base Steam FE4; F210 Space Age data/runtime on standalone8DC
matrix.observed: Beta optional consumer publishes copper-cable +0.01 during final-fixes and immediately inspects its result. Original Base worlds produce 200 then 202 cables from equal 100-plate batches, without modules or beacons; save and two unchanged-save cold reloads pass.
matrix.limit: Retain D3/FE4 and original package identities. Space Age client/data presence does not establish physical cable output there. See N2.

matrix.subject: add_technology single wrapper
matrix.observed: Host checks immediate single publication and detached submitted input. Source delegates to the same admitted bounded family path.
matrix.limit: Native Alpha calls add_technologies and Beta calls add_productivity. Those are not relabelled as an executed single-wrapper call. See N1.

matrix.subject: duplicate/conflict/error/input-output isolation and pre-publication rejection
matrix.observed: Existing host opponents cover duplicate names and recipes, missing targets, cycles/metatables/executable/sparse inputs, arbitrary fields, formulas, invalid effects/native bounds, publication errors and mutation isolation. Runtime missing force/technology and detached outputs also have actual Alpha/Beta native observations.
matrix.limit: Host before-write counts are not native prototype-write receipts. A small caught native data-stage conformance case can close the named single/duplicate/invalid/mutation cases together; do not turn every arbitrary schema into another native campaign. See N1. Foreign remote-interface collision has host-only no-replacement proof and remains explicit for independent freeze review.

matrix.subject: get_research / missing state / no mutation / native levels
matrix.targets: F200 Base; F210 Base/Space Age clients
matrix.observed: Queries inspect exact finite/native fields, mutate detached response tables and query again, preserving force modifiers. Missing technology and unused uint32 force return distinct error codes. on_load only reconnects pending local work; game queries wait for game-available callbacks.
matrix.limit: No derived completed-level promise. Host tests cover malformed force/technology and unavailable-game behavior. No whole-catalogue or foreign world scan is introduced.

matrix.subject: optional absence
matrix.observed: F200 exact four-mod CreateOnly witness confirms no MIR interface/technology/productivity and optional Beta guard. MIR is absent, so newer MIR player bytes are not consumed. Recovered F210 actual two-mod FE4 world loads the byte-exact AB93 optional Beta archive and exits0; its first-line absent-MIR guards match current source and return before every changed body/import/callback.
matrix.limit: Original F210 dirty-source label and actual two-mod/FE4 scope remain explicit. It does not become the later four-mod explicit absence-state observer or a standalone8DC result. Original profile bytes were not recovered; actual loaded selection, own archive/member bytes, engine, native log and ledger are recovered. No replacement is required solely because the later profile exists.

matrix.subject: namespace and public imports / historical consumers
matrix.targets: F210 native namespace pair; F200/F210 normal Alpha/Beta
matrix.observed: Two differently named native namespace consumers retain their own private platform.target and publish distinct gear/cable effects through public fully qualified API imports. The bounded 31-archive audit found zero literal old-interface/SDK/MEP matches. Historical browser/settings runtime interfaces remain implemented.
matrix.limit: CreateOnly namespace result is not physical/save/client proof. Unknown computed names/external archives remain unknown. No consumed old contract is removed and no new adapter/history framework is required.

matrix.subject: combined submission budgets / deterministic cost
matrix.observed: 100 retained observations cover named family sizes and over-wide/deep refusals. Limits combine 64 family rows,512 definition entries,depth16,4096-byte strings/keys,64 recipe targets. Named 1/8/16/32-row shapes publish once; a populated64-row shape can exceed the shared entry budget.
matrix.limit: Do not silently raise limits or promise all64 populated rows fit. Host elapsed includes observer overhead and excludes native internals. No API performance acceptance follows.

finite_missing_native_queue.outcome: One bounded native data-stage conformance load on each pinned modern engine, using only the current public helper.
finite_missing_native_queue.expected: Call single add_technology for one independent native row; prove returned identity/immediate effect and detached submitted input. Catch a duplicate and one invalid-field family with pcall, require exact MIR_API code and no named intended technology writes; include detached metadata/returned-order check. Keep unrelated sentinels unchanged. Reuse independent Alpha/Beta; do not modify player helpers.
finite_missing_native_queue.command_seam: Existing Invoke-NativeFixture.ps1 -CreateOnly with exact frozen profile/FixtureSources/ConsumerMarkers; actual owned archives, pins, caller and preflight must be prepared first.
finite_missing_native_queue.failure: Preserve original engine log/selection/result. A native admission discrepancy requires a bounded correction and affected rerun; do not weaken the supported subset.

finite_missing_native_queue.outcome: F200/F210 Space Age physical API Beta output, completion save and two cold reloads.
finite_missing_native_queue.expected: Retain equal100 plate inputs -> baseline200/researched202 cables, +0.01 native recipe effect, empty modules/no beacons, Alpha +0.05 and detached queries; use the actual official Space Age dependencies on D3/8DC. Do not open a Base/MIR5 save in an older comparator or mix DLC changes into a protected migration.
finite_missing_native_queue.command_seam: Existing Invoke-NativeFixture.ps1 -CaseName api-beta-production with Alpha/Beta consumer markers and separately pinned Space Age profile; existing create/production/save/two-cold path. No new runner.
finite_missing_native_queue.failure: Preserve run/log/save. Diagnose actual expansion recipe/effect or fixture assumption independently; original Base evidence remains unchanged.

release_decision.required: Independent reviewer reconciles this exact supported subset, retained evidence, final candidate and completed N1/N2 receipts before removing draft3. No API expansion is requested.
release_decision.source_change_rule: Thin test fixtures/profile metadata do not invalidate unrelated native production/migrations. Actual helper/schema/registration changes require their affected checks.
release_decision.not_applicable: Unsupported historical API operation is not advertised as implemented; this modern F200/F210 subset does not turn the nine stable player editions into API-general targets.
